title: Chapter 438 Both Sides Suffer
content:
Chapter 438 Both Sides Suffer

The reason why they were able to fight for several rounds before was that the opponent did not use a big move.

Wang Shuo flew backwards again, stirring up a pile of dust.

Under the surprised eyes of the Sword God, Wang Shuo walked out again.

At this time, the Sword God reacted and realized that this kid should have activated a skill like invincibility.

The Sword God was knowledgeable and soon realized Wang Shuo's state.

So he stopped wasting his internal energy and focused on dealing with the Ice Phoenix Emperor.

In his prime, the Ice Phoenix Emperor could not even resist a big move of the Sword God.

But now, after being hit hard by the Sword God, the Ice Phoenix Emperor was only slightly injured.

Wang Shuo is now in an invincible state, so he will not waste time.

So he launched a crazy attack on the Sword God.

He still did not release Shura Slash.

The more anger he has, the more powerful Shura Slash is.

The internal energy in Wang Shuo's body recovered quickly in the red pupil state. As long as he can release a skill, Wang Shuo will release it immediately.

Soon, the time for absolute defense is coming.

Wang Shuo immediately stepped forward and approached the Sword God, preparing to release "Shura Slash" at close range.

Wang Shuo thought that even if there were control skills, the Sword God would probably break free quickly, or even be immune.

He had encountered immune control before.

Finally, Wang Shuo got the chance, "Iron Chain Binding" and "Shura Slash".

The two skills were seamlessly connected.

The Sword God was shocked to see Wang Shuo burst out with such a powerful blow.

He was seriously injured and might not be able to take this blow. Even if he took this blow, he would probably be injured.

"Little thief, you are playing dirty!"

The Sword God immediately cast a light shield to cover his body. At the same time, the long sword burst out with dazzling light in the sky.

But it was not fired.

Shura Slash slashed on the light shield, and there was a huge explosion around. Although the light shield resisted most of the damage, the Sword God was still chopped and flew backwards.

Obviously, the Sword God was seriously injured again, and the injury was more serious than the battle in Shenwu City.

Wang Shuo's attack was almost equivalent to a full-strength attack from a high-level general.

Just when Wang Shuo thought the outcome was decided, the Sword God's sword in the sky moved.

It attacked Wang Shuo's neck with lightning speed.

Wang Shuo's invincible state at this time was over.

This is the terrifying thing about the Sword God. Even if he is seriously injured, he must fight back.

Wang Shuo's soul suddenly flew away. Obviously, this is also a big move of the Sword God.

If Wang Shuo still has health attributes at this time.

I'm afraid only blood is left.

Because he also has a passive skill, immune to fatal blows.

Although he was not beheaded by a sword, he was already in a state of death. If he was not treated in time, death was only a matter of time.

The Sword God's sword circled in the air, returned to the Sword God, and disappeared with the Sword God.

At this time, Wang Shuo couldn't even speak.

But he was not very panicked in his heart, after all, he still had a resurrection coin.

It's just that he didn't know how to change this dying state.

At this moment, no matter what he did, he couldn't wake up.

Now he seemed to be in a mysterious space, unable to find a way out.

After a brief panic, Wang Shuo decided to practice the "Black Dragon Sutra" and "Dragon Spear Technique".

He thought of Ayubza's breakthrough before his death, could it be the same?

So, he calmed down and practiced slowly.

Time seemed to have passed for a long time, as long as several years, but in the outside world, it was only a few breaths.
